propositions: Collapse transition's two force flags (--force for start-work gate bypass, --force-close for close gate bypass) into a single --force[=<reason>] that dispatches by target status
Rename CLI flag --force-close to --force with clean break (no deprecation alias); stale callers must fail explicitly via CommandError, not silently skip
Explicit rejection branch in _parse_flags raises CommandError for both --force-close and --force-close=<value>, preventing silent no-op behavior from hand-rolled unknown-token loop
On close transition, bare --force yields reason '(no reason given)' and bypasses completion gate; --force=<reason> supplies explicit reason, matching claim command behavior
On open→in_progress transition, --force still bypasses start-work gate; --force --reason=x preserves x as audit note via new force_reason kwarg to transition_compute
